company.name: HyperPay
company.description: HyperPay is a fintech company that provides payment gateway, solutions, and services for e-commerce and merchants. The company offers businesses with a dynamic array of integrated payment solutions and financial services to help businesses transition to a cashless society and positively impact people's lives and business growth. It also provides merchants with a broad array of products and services in addition to payment processing, including risk and fraud management, monitoring system, installments, and invoicing systems among others.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $36,786,629, or 72.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,726,578 to $239,514,349, a 64.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 49 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
